doc:
Proof of Creativity module for the MySocial network
 Manages content originality verification through oracle analysis,
 PoC badge issuance, revenue redirection, and community dispute voting

create_poc_beneficiary_admin_cap.doc: Create admin capability for username beneficiary provisioning (bootstrap only).

bootstrap_init.doc: Bootstrap initialization function - creates the PoC configuration and registry

create_username_beneficiary.doc: Provision a username beneficiary vault for an off-platform creator (admin only).

end_username_beneficiary.doc: End an active username beneficiary provision (admin only).

claim_username_beneficiary.doc: Oracle-verified claim of a provisioned username beneficiary.

claim_username_beneficiary_vault_balance.doc: Claim vault balance for a username-beneficiary-linked creator wallet (one-time join referral on first claim).

run_analyze_and_update_post.doc:
Oracle analyzes content and updates post PoC status. Does not require a social token pool.
 `derivative_redirection_target`: wallet (0) or beneficiary vault (1) when similarity is detected.
 `embedded_audio_only_derivative`: VIDEO only — oracle detected match on embedded audio track; uses `audio_threshold` and `video_embedded_audio_redirect_bps` ceiling with the same delta ramp.
 `apply_explicit_outcome` + `explicit_poc_outcome == 4`: royalty-free — accumulation via beneficiary vault (same as escrow redirect mode).

analyze_and_update_post_sync_token_pool.doc: Same as `analyze_and_update_post`, then mirrors PoC redirect fields onto `TokenPool` when the post has an SPT registry entry.

claim_beneficiary_vault_balance.doc: Claim accumulated balance for coin type `T` from a beneficiary vault (splits per config bps + optional referrer).

submit_poc_dispute.doc: Submit a PoC dispute with community voting

vote_on_dispute.doc: Cast a vote on a PoC dispute (community voting)

resolve_dispute_voting.doc: Resolve PoC dispute after voting period ends

resolve_dispute_voting_sync_token_pool.doc: Same as `resolve_dispute_voting`, then mirrors post PoC state onto `TokenPool` when the post has an SPT registry entry.

claim_voting_reward.doc: Claim voting rewards after dispute resolution

bps_to_redirect_percent.doc: Converts basis points (0-10000) to redirect percent 0-100 for `post::revenue_redirect_percentage` (nearest integer percent).

get_threshold_for_media_type.doc: Get similarity threshold for a media type

is_authorized_oracle.doc: Check if an address is the authorized oracle

has_poc_data.doc: Check if a post has PoC data that can be disputed

get_dispute_voting_status.doc: Get dispute voting status; `current_time_ms` should be `clock::timestamp_ms(clock)`.

has_user_voted.doc: Check if user has already voted on dispute

config_version.doc: Get the version of the PoC config

dispute_version.doc: Get the version of a PoC dispute

registry_version.doc: Get the version of the PoC registry

create_poc_admin_cap.doc:
Create a PoCAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

PoCAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for Proof of Creativity system management

PoCConfig.doc: Global configuration for Proof of Creativity system

oracle_address.doc: Oracle address authorized to submit analysis results

image_threshold.doc: Similarity thresholds for different media types (stored as percentages 0-100)

revenue_redirect_percentage.doc: Percentage of revenue to redirect when similarity detected (0-100)

dispute_cost.doc: Cost to submit a dispute (paid to ecosystem treasury)

min_vote_stake.doc: Minimum stake amount required to vote on disputes

max_vote_stake.doc: Maximum stake amount allowed per vote

voting_duration_ms.doc: Voting period duration in milliseconds (on-chain clock)

max_evidence_urls.doc: Maximum number of evidence URLs allowed

max_votes_per_dispute.doc: Maximum number of votes allowed per dispute

dispute_governance_id.doc: Governance registry ID for PoC disputes

claim_treasury_fee_bps.doc: Treasury fee (bps of gross) taken at vault claim

max_referral_bps.doc: Max referral fee (bps of post-treasury gross) when beneficiary supplies `Some(referrer)` at claim

video_embedded_audio_redirect_bps.doc: Max redirect ceiling for VIDEO posts when only embedded audio matches (`embedded_audio_only_derivative`), in bps (0-10000)

dispute_quorum_base_stake.doc: Minimum total voting stake (`uphold` + `overturn`) for round 1 to count as full participation (`0` disables).

dispute_second_round_fee_multiplier_bps.doc: Round-2 fee multiplier in bps; applied as `dispute_cost * bps / 10000`. Must be >= 10000.

dispute_second_round_quorum_multiplier_b.doc: Round-2 quorum multiplier in bps; applied as `dispute_quorum_base_stake * bps / 10000`. Must be >= 10000.

username_beneficiary_join_referral_bps.doc: One-time join-referral fee (bps of post-treasury gross) on first username-beneficiary vault claim.

Vote.doc: Individual vote record in a dispute

stake_amount.doc: Amount of MySo staked with this vote

PoCDispute.doc: Dispute challenging a PoC badge or revenue redirection with community voting

disputer.doc: Address that submitted the dispute (post owner)

dispute_type.doc: Type of dispute (challenging badge or redirection)

evidence.doc: Evidence or reasoning provided by disputer

votes.doc: All votes cast on this dispute

voter_records.doc: Mapping of voter addresses to prevent double voting

voting_rewards_claimed.doc: Prevents double-claim of voting rewards after resolution

reward_pool.doc: Total reward pool from losing side (set after resolution)

dispute_round.doc: 1 = first dispute on post, 2 = second (final allowed).

effective_dispute_fee.doc: Fee charged when this dispute was opened.

required_total_stake_quorum.doc: Minimum `uphold_stake + overturn_stake` for stake-weighted outcome (else default uphold).

PoCRegistry.doc: Simplified registry to track PoC statistics

total_votes_cast.doc: Total votes cast across all disputes

PoCResultAppliedEvent.doc: Emitted when oracle applies an explicit or similarity-based PoC outcome (for indexers).

AnalysisSubmittedEvent.doc: Event emitted when oracle submits analysis results

PoCBadgeIssuedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a PoC badge is issued

PoCDisputeSubmittedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a PoC dispute is submitted

evidence.doc: Disputer evidence (duplicate of shared `PoCDispute`; for indexers/RPC consumption).

DisputeVoteCastEvent.doc: Event emitted when a vote is cast on a dispute

PoCDisputeResolvedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a dispute is resolved

VotingRewardClaimedEvent.doc: Event emitted when voting rewards are claimed

PoCConfigUpdatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when PoC configuration is updated
